task_objective: Merge the four completed and reviewed feature plans from dev into main and publish patch release v0.10.3.
design_decisions: Use v0.10.3 because main and the latest published release are at v0.10.2 and the requested release type is patch.
Promote the complete local dev branch containing error-position navigation, the headless query CLI, count-all-rows, and result pagination.
Build the GitHub release title and notes from CHANGELOG.md before tagging, as required by the release workflow.
Increment README image cacheBuster values from 34 to 35 for the new release tag.
Use scripts/orchestration-hooks/finalize-release patch on main for the version bump, release commit, annotated tag, and push.
known_limitations: Offscreen end-to-end verification found that an immediate second pagination click can be ignored during the brief interval after a page renders but before its worker finishes; ordinary navigation after the worker settles is correct.

results.feature_verification: Real DuckDB CLI and offscreen Qt workflows passed for all four features.
results.quality_gates: 825 passed, 7 deselected, 91% coverage after release preparation; the full gate is rerun on main before tagging.
results.release_automation: The tag-triggered CI, GitHub release, release assets, and PyPI publication are verified after v0.10.3 is pushed.
